trap.label: who/which/whose
trap.wrong: People whose their time is limited. Groups who meet weekly. The man that his car was stolen.
trap.right: People whose time is limited. Groups that meet weekly. The man whose car was stolen.
trap.why: Em português “cujo” é raro e a fala o troca por “que o… dele”. O brasileiro põe the/his depois de whose. Em inglês, whose já indica posse e substitui o possessivo.

fix.wrong: The woman whose her son is a pilot.
fix.right: The woman whose son is a pilot.

fix.wrong: The man who his bike broke.

rewrite.prompt: Una com whose: “I know a man. His car is red.”
rewrite.answer: I know a man whose car is red.

rewrite.prompt: Una com who: “She is a nurse. She helps kids.”
rewrite.answer: She is a nurse who helps kids.

rewrite.prompt: Una com that: “These are groups. They meet monthly.”
rewrite.answer: These are groups that meet monthly.
